g.title: cluster_genome
g.text: ① 유전체 불안정성 · 기원세포 (Genomic catastrophe & cell of origin)

g.title: cluster_tumour
g.text: ② 종양세포 프로그램 (Tumour-cell program & osteoid production)

g.title: cluster_immune
g.text: ④ 종양 미세환경 · 면역 (Immune microenvironment — the only compartment mifamurtide touches)

g.title: cluster_vasc
g.text: ⑤ 혈관신생 · 저산소 · 약물 침투 (Angiogenesis, hypoxia and the penetration penalty)

g.title: cluster_bone
g.text: ③ 골 재형성 악순환 (The vicious cycle — a GROWTH term, not a SURVIVAL term)

g.title: cluster_met
g.text: ⑥ 전이 캐스케이드 · 포아송 구조 (The metastatic cascade — a Poisson bet on lesions nobody can see)

g.title: cluster_mtx
g.text: ⑦ 고용량 메토트렉세이트 PK · 신장 양성 피드백 루프 (HDMTX 12 g/m² — the drug is cleared through the organ it destroys)

g.title: cluster_rescue
g.text: ⑧ 류코보린 구조요법 · 글루카르피다제 (Rescue — a shared clock, and a rescue that arrives too late)

g.title: cluster_dox
g.text: ⑨ 독소루비신 · 심장 천장 (Doxorubicin — the ceiling dexrazoxane can actually move)

g.title: cluster_cis
g.text: ⑩ 시스플라틴 · 세뇨관 · 와우 (Cisplatin — two irreversible ceilings, one of them shared with methotrexate)

g.title: cluster_ie
g.text: ⑪ 이포스파미드 · 에토포시드 (MAPIE escalation — buys cycles by giving up backbone)

g.title: cluster_other
g.text: ⑫ 골표적 · 면역 · 항혈관 약제 (Bone-directed, immune and anti-angiogenic agents — the negative trials)

g.title: cluster_tox
g.text: ⑬ 독성 · 용량 강도 조절기 (The governor — go/no-go gates are where escalation SPENDS the budget)

g.title: cluster_surg
g.text: ⑭ 국소 치료 (Local control — where the primary leaves the model at week 11)

g.title: cluster_end
g.text: ⑮ 임상 종말점 (Clinical endpoints — read the SURVIVAL column, not the kill column)
